title: Rational Curves on Compact Kähler Manifolds
exact_target: Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold. Is $X$ covered by rational curves if and only if $K_X$ is not pseudoeffective? If $K_X$ is pseudoeffective but not nef, must $X$ contain a rational curve?
